notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34346652/bd4c674b01b9db21437b28e84f1056e7c7c12af3.png
I hope everyone enjoys this new Coronavirus inspired update! The spread of germs is something on everyone's mind lately, so I added it into the game. Employees can spread the virus among each other, so how you design your office is going to be very important!

Patch Notes
Added contagion
Added virus spread
Added coughing

Fixed camera bug
Restricted camera movement to prevent losing office
Changed default camera control settings
Fixed lighting bug
Fixed computer lights
Increased employee profitability
Fixed hire button

notes.title: Beginner's Guide
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34346652/9fb17a8a469ef4a25faa2f74df51f112d27bfbc2.png
This is a short guide to help players reach profitability in Wall Street Tycoon.
Step 1: Hiring
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34346652/ff8084590d9c237840a16d0f3cc8b191fd6d3eb4.png
Make sure to run background checks before hiring new employees. You want to keep these stats in mind when deciding who to hire. Talent and work ethic are two very important traits!


Step 2: Training
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34346652/650ca1a24cc0502d26a6e42e6a3655249d711990.png
Don't forget to train your employees! Just like real life, no one starts off being amazing at their job. They need training, and it will cost you in the short term (you have to pay them but they aren't producing work), however long term the investment will pay off. Their increased skill will produce more work and profit for the company.


Step 3: Profit
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34346652/5f0f4b96c6fb2b194c5eacbad750c1670d9b3e3a.png
From this point, the company will be more profitable allowing you to expand and grow the company. However growing too fast can lead to bankruptcy as expenses spike up.


Step  4: Raises
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34346652/516bf980754d939ba87b86252b09786de8eb44f8.png
Don't forget to give your employees raises to keep them happy and working for you. Try to keep their pay fair with individual skill levels, employees that become very talented expect fair compensation for their work.


Good luck, have fun! You'll figure out the rest :)
